name: WL 17

paper.title: Grain Growth and Dust Segregation Revealed by Multi-wavelength Analysis of the Class I Protostellar Disk WL 17

notes: Class I protostar in the rho Ophiuchus (L1688) molecular cloud. ALMA Band 3 (3.1mm) and Band 7 (0.87mm) reveal different disk substructures (off-center hole in Band 7, central symmetric hole in Band 3) and a low mean spectral index (alpha=2.28+/-0.02), suggestive of grain growth and dust segregation on the protostellar-disk scale; disk may be massive and gravitationally unstable, possibly forming a single Jupiter-mass protoplanet via gravitational instability. Distance of 137 pc adopted as the mean distance to the L1688 region.
